articles.summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq Capital Market: NBBK ), the holding company of Needham Bank (the "Bank"), today announced its second quarter 2026 financial results. Net income for the second quarter of 2026 amounted to $21.1 million, or $0.53 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $15.0 million, or $0.36 per diluted common share, for the prior quarter. articles.title: NB Bancorp, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
